rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when “lame” means boring or unfunny, rather than describing a physical walking problem or a weak excuse.

example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 mou4 liu4

rows.note: Use this for a person or animal unable to walk normally because of a leg or foot problem.

example.english: The dog is lame and has trouble walking.
example.jyutping: zek3 gau2 bai1 goek3 haang4 dak1 hou2 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this for an excuse or explanation that does not sound convincing.

example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 go3 ze6 hau2 taai3 hin1 koeng5 laa3
